tests.name: Home shows one "last updated" time offline
tests.assertion: Online visit fills the cache; airplane mode + cold launch: Home shows the offline banner with its time and NO second stamp under the ticker (exactly one timestamp). Online-but-saved-data (banner gone, data still from the phone): the stamp is shown

tests.name: /cold-storage failed load (app)
tests.assertion: Cache emptied, airplane mode, cold launch: /cold-storage shows the "could not load" notice with "try again" (no ErrorBoundary, no uncaught error, no spinner left); back online, "try again" loads the list
tests.notes: notice after 1803 ms; 75 cache entries cleared first

tests.name: Post page location fallback
tests.assertion: Logged in, /post step 3, "use my current location": GPS on → coordinates near the emulator position (which step: cached ≤ 10 min / fresh ≤ 20 s recorded); GPS off → within ~25 s the clear fallback message and the cursor in the village field, no crash
tests.notes: needs a logged-in account (Post is behind login); the prod flavour is read-only — no account may be created or used there. Run in the staging suite after S4.
